traceability.notes:
All functional requirements in docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md are fully implemented and backed by targeted unit tests, integration tests with real Prettier + ESLint, and updated user-facing documentation.
Implementation details: - CatchClause dual-position detection is implemented via gatherCatchClauseCommentText and wired through gatherBranchCommentText and getBranchAnnotationInfo used by the require-branch-annotation rule. - The function prioritizes before-catch annotations when they contain @story/@req and falls back to inside-catch comments (via getCommentsInside or a line-based scan) when needed, matching REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION, REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC, and REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY. - Auto-fix behavior for CatchClause computes indentation and insertion index inside the catch block body (before the first statement or just inside the block), ensuring Prettier preserves the inserted annotations (REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX). - Dedicated unit tests cover all key behaviors (priority, fallback, inside-body detection, and insert position), and integration tests verify that Prettier-formatted code with catch annotations passes the require-branch-annotation rule. - The API reference in user-docs documents both valid annotation positions, priority rules, and Prettier-aware auto-fix behavior for catch clauses.
All related tests pass in the current test run, and no regressions are evident in other branch types. Therefore, this story is fully satisfied.
